{
  "document_ids": ["SPEC:KernelWorld"],
  "extraction_type": "causal_dependency",
  "proposals": [
    {
      "id": "P001",
      "type": "authority_boundary",
      "source": "CanonicalAuthority",
      "target": "ExecutionAuthority",
      "direction": "CanonicalAuthority → ExecutionAuthority",
      "evidence": "DelegationGraph allows : CanonicalAuthority -> ExecutionAuthority -> Prop",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": ["AUTH-001"],
      "notes": "Defines the strict boundary where authority is delegated from canonical to execution contexts."
    },
    {
      "id": "P002",
      "type": "defines",
      "source": "EventFact",
      "target": "Executable",
      "direction": "EventFact → Executable",
      "evidence": "EventFact includes authority_proof : Executable(ctx, act)",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": ["AUTH-001", "DET-001"],
      "notes": "Event facts are causally dependent on the prior determination of executability."
    },
    {
      "id": "P003",
      "type": "defines",
      "source": "EventFact",
      "target": "Projection",
      "direction": "EventFact → Projection",
      "evidence": "EventFact includes transition_proof : p2 == apply_intent(act.intent, p1)",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": ["DET-001", "PUR-001"],
      "notes": "Deterministic transition from p1 to p2 is a core invariant of the event fact."
    },
    {
      "id": "P004",
      "type": "depends_on",
      "source": "Runtime(Consumed)",
      "target": "Runtime(Available)",
      "direction": "Runtime(Available) → Runtime(Consumed)",
      "evidence": "step_runtime takes Runtime(ctx, TokenState.Available) and returns Runtime(ctx, TokenState.Consumed)",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": ["RUN-001"],
      "notes": "Token lifecycle transition: Available state is consumed to produce a new Available state and a Consumed token."
    },
    {
      "id": "P005",
      "type": "invariant",
      "source": "History",
      "target": "Projection",
      "direction": "History → Projection",
      "evidence": "THEOREM HISTORY.INDEX_HOMOMORPHISM.001: project(ctx, p, h) == p",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": ["PUR-001"],
      "notes": "Projection is causally indexed by history; the projection of a history must equal its current state."
    },
    {
      "id": "P006",
      "type": "constrains",
      "source": "InternalCapability",
      "target": "Executable",
      "direction": "InternalCapability → Executable",
      "evidence": "executable : Forall(a : KernelAction(ctx), allowed_action(a) -> Executable(ctx, a))",
      "confidence": 1.0,
      "related_invariants": ["AUTH-001"],
      "notes": "Capabilities constrain which actions are considered executable within the context."
    },
    {
      "id": "P007",
      "type": "event_fact_candidate",
      "source": "step_runtime",
      "target": "Event",
      "direction": "step_runtime → Event",
      "evidence": "step_runtime produces nextP and nextRt, matching the structure of EventFact's transition and authority proofs",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "related_invariants": ["DET-001", "RUN-001"],
      "notes": "The step_runtime operation appears to be the runtime mechanism generating EventFacts."
    }
  ],
  "key_invariants_detected": [
    "PUR-001",
    "AUTH-001",
    "DET-001",
    "RUN-001"
  ],
  "authority_boundaries": [
    "CanonicalAuthority -> ExecutionAuthority"
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "How is the initial Projection defined for Empty History?",
    "What constitutes the proof h_allowed in step_runtime?",
    "How are scope_boundary strings in InternalCapability validated against CanonicalAuthority?"
  ]
}
